title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
focus: Explain the batch normalizing transform for one activation over a small mini-batch. Let the learner edit the mini-batch values, epsilon, and the scale gamma and shift beta. Show the mini-batch mean, the variance, the normalized values and the outputs. Check that the normalized values have mean zero, that gamma = 1 and beta = 0 leave the normalized values unchanged, and that a batch of identical values gives all-zero normalized values.
